games_meta_description: Every game braggster scores: {n} score sheets across cards, dice, board and sports, plus {play} you can play inside the app. Filter by category or by in-app play.
games_intro: Cards, dice, board, puzzles and sports, plus a blank scorecard for anything else. Real scoring rules, not just a notepad: bowling carries strike and spare bonuses, Yahtzee has the upper bonus and the joker rule, and {low} games rank lowest wins. You can play {play} of them right inside the app, no physical set needed.
games_free_note: Free to start does not mean every game is free. You get the blank scorecard and the Freestyle card and dice table, both always free, plus one game of your choice that stays free forever. The rest are paid.

privacy_meta_description: Braggster keeps your scores on your device. No accounts, no ads, no cookies. The only thing the app collects is crash diagnostics, and you can switch it off.
privacy_intro: Braggster keeps your scores on your phone. There is no server and there are no accounts. We collect one thing, crash diagnostics, and you can switch it off in Settings. Here is what that means in practice.
privacy_collect_p: One thing: crash diagnostics. When the app crashes, Firebase Crashlytics sends us the crash details, your device model, your OS version and an install id that Crashlytics generates itself. It is not linked to your identity and is never used to track you. It is on by default, and you can turn it off under Send crash reports in Settings, which also deletes any reports still waiting to be sent. Nothing else is collected: no analytics, no advertising, no trackers. We never see your games, your players, or your scores.
privacy_stored_p: Your games, players, scores and settings are stored only on your device. If you delete the app, that data is gone. If you share a game with another device, it travels straight between the two devices and never passes through us.
privacy_share_p: We sell nothing to anyone. Crash diagnostics go to Firebase Crashlytics, a Google service, and we use them only to fix bugs. If you buy a game, Apple or Google handles the payment; we never see your card details and we have no server that records what you bought. Nothing else leaves your device, so there is nothing else to share.
privacy_website_p: braggster.com is a static site hosted on GitHub Pages. It uses Microsoft Clarity to see which parts of the page people read and where they get stuck. Clarity runs in cookieless mode here: it sets no cookies, it cannot recognise you across visits, and it gets a fresh anonymous id on every page view. It receives your IP address, your browser, your device type, and the clicks and scrolling you do on the page. We use this only to improve the site, and we never combine it with anything from the app. GitHub also keeps standard server logs, including your IP address, to serve the page and guard against abuse.
privacy_children_p: Braggster is suitable for all ages. The crash diagnostics above are the only thing we collect from anyone, child or adult. They are not linked to identity, never used for tracking, and you can switch them off in Settings.
privacy_rights_p: Under the GDPR you can access, correct and delete your personal data. We hold nothing that identifies you: crash diagnostics are not linked to your identity, so we cannot tie them back to you, and your games, players and scores never leave your device. If you would rather send nothing at all, turn crash reports off in Settings.
privacy_changes_p: If this policy changes, we will update this page and the date above.
privacy_contact_p: Questions about privacy? Mail us at
support_meta_description: Need a hand with Braggster? Email support@braggster.com and we will help you get back to game night.
support_intro: Something not working, or just have a question? We are glad to help. Braggster keeps everything on your device, so there is no account to recover: nearly everything can be sorted out over email.
support_email_p: The fastest way to reach us is email. Write to us at
support_include_p: To help us help you quickly, tell us your device and its OS version, the game you were scoring, and what you expected to happen against what actually did. A screenshot goes a long way.
support_response_p: We are a small team and we read every message. You can expect a reply within a few working days.
